summary: F-1 fixed: the long unbroken texts of the two-step page now wrap inside the panel. The cause was the unwrapped key (#secret-text, 32 capitals in bold) and the otpauth address widening the column, which dragged the note past the panel edge where the page's overflow clipping hid it. One rule .wrap-any { overflow-wrap: anywhere } in site.css, used on the note, the key and the address.

The «enter the code» prompt after a right password is now a neutral status line (#prompt, class msg-text, no error label) inside the code row, with the code field focused; any real error (wrong code, wrong password) still uses the error box, and a new submit clears the prompt. The text is the existing auth_err_totp_required value, so no key was added.
